result.title: ProofPaths: An AI Agent Framework for Assessing Student Reasoning
result.comment: Accepted at the 8th Workshop on Education for High Performance Computing (EduHiPC 2026). 6 pages, 3 figures. https://proofpaths.github.io
result.summary: Students can use large language models to complete assignments, but a correct solution does not establish whether they understand the reasoning behind it. Individualized interviews can probe that understanding but require recurring staff effort. We introduce ProofPaths, an AI agentic framework that combines rubric-based grading with individualized and interactive interviews. Multiple grading agents assess a submission against instructor guidance, exchange critiques, and revise their judgments. Their scores determine which review supplies the grade and feedback. An interview agent asks students to justify steps in their submission and uses their answers to guide follow-up questions. Each question is linked to a retrieved submission excerpt, so instructors can compare the student's explanation with the cited passage. The system tracks assessment progress and stores grading reviews and interview transcripts for each submission. Several deterministic tests of the assessment controllers check source handling, score aggregation, and limits on correction attempts. Instructors can inspect all reviews and transcripts and override grades within the assignment workflow.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ProofPaths，一个把评分与个性化追问结合的教育评估智能体框架：多个评分 agent 依教师指引互评并修正判断，由得分决定最终评分与反馈来源；访谈 agent 要求学生为提交中的步骤辩护，并据此生成后续问题，所有评审与访谈记录均可供教师核查与覆盖。
AI.relevance_reason: 把每个追问绑定到检索出的提交片段、并以有限次修正与进度追踪控制评估流程，可能为 LVR 中证据引用的可核查性与「何时停止追问/停止推理」提供概念参照，但该工作不涉及视觉输入或内部 latent 状态，联系较远。
